release_notes:
1. Modern Grouped Event Routing Interface: Reorganized Advertising Platform DataLayers & Event Routing into 3 collapsible, colored event groups (Product Discovery, Cart & Checkout, Conversion) with official platform brand badges and custom event icons.
2. Unified Form Architecture: Eliminated duplicate form inputs across views to ensure 100% reliable settings persistence on save.
3. View Mode Switcher: Seamless switching between By Event Group and Full List display modes.
4. Quick-Toggle Controls & Slide-Out Inspect Drawer: Instant row and column batch toggling and deep event parameter inspection.
